description: This file defines a Python service class 'IntegrationsService' that orchestrates interactions with external integration systems such as Collibra and Immuta. It provides methods to publish metadata, register datasets/policies, and map external system errors to standardized error types, serving as an abstraction layer for integration logic.

classes.name: IntegrationsService
classes.description: A service class for managing external integrations with methods to publish metadata, register datasets, and handle error mapping.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,Dict[str,Any]] publish_collibra(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Publishes metadata to the Collibra system.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,Dict[str,Any]] register_immuta(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Registers a dataset or policy in Immuta.

methods.name: GateFailureDomainError map_collibra_failure(self, message: str)
methods.description: Converts Collibra validation failures into a standard domain error.

methods.name: ForbiddenError map_immuta_denial(self, message: str)
methods.description: Converts Immuta access denials into a Forbidden error.

ctags.pattern: /^    def publish_collibra(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, Dict[str, Any]]:$/
